93675fb99001468b620a.text: In this age of technology, many young people obtain much of the information

eef7c69fd09131dde9e5.text: they need from online viewing materials. Such materials mostly come from Youtube, Instagram, and Snapchat—the most popular online platforms among teens based on a new Pew Research Center Survey (Anderson and Jiang, 2018).

896b0590e6cfa5a3b04f.text: As a student, you must enhance your capacity to filter information obtained from

2dc842198b96dbc05f28.text: such sources. It will make you avoid misinformation, which has recently become prevalent due to fake news. You also need to sharpen your skill in judging the relevance and worth of their content before using them as bases for personal decisions, especially when dealing with social issues, concerns in real life.

45a762da46a04cf9dc61.text: In making sound judgments about the overall quality of information presented

9727cda7ce339983488b.text: in a viewing material, you need to consider the following elements: 1. Relevance: the information's level of importance to a particular viewing

bc568e762acc2aa86b11.text: purpose or explicitly stated need for that information

f64363738acd61542fec.text: 2. Accuracy: the extent to which information contains factual and updated details that can be verified by consulting alternative and/or primary sources

522c4a003fe8db431a61.text: 3. Bias/Perspective: the position or slant toward which an author shapes information

770c6a737e89673e54d7.text: 4. Reliability: the information's level of trustworthiness based on information about the author and the publishing body
